strings.string: Goal pace for runs without a workout (e.g. 9:20)

Minutes:seconds per mile, or per km if your watch shows metric pace. 9:20 = 9 min 20 s per mile. Drives the ON PACE band, AHEAD/BEHIND and alerts when no workout target is active. Leave blank for none.
How far from the goal pace still counts as ON PACE. Default 10 seconds per mile/km.
Goal heart rate instead of pace (e.g. 2 or 130-145)

For easy and recovery runs without a workout. 2 = your heart rate zone 2 (from the watch's running zones), 1-2 = zones 1 to 2, 130-145 = a range in bpm, 145 = only warn above 145. When set, the band says HR OK / HR HIGH / HR LOW instead of judging pace, even if a goal pace is set. Leave blank to use the goal pace.
Vibrate when you drift off pace or heart rate
Goals only (workouts alert on their own)

Official race distance in your watch's distance units, e.g. 13.11 for a half marathon in miles or 21.1 in km. The finish then reads exactly this even if the course file measures a little long or short. Only applies when the loaded course is within 5% of it. Set back to 0 after the race.
ON PACE band: seconds of pace to average
Default 30. Higher is steadier but slower to react.
